diagnosis.narrative: The series is dominated by a moderate downward trend (a net fall of ~67% of its level). Seasonality is strong (period 24): a repeating cycle explains much of the movement. Across validation windows the model ranking is moderate (Kendall tau 0.626), which favours a selective combination.
